recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future deprecation or replacement of example should be handled by a final later tracker, not by re-opening FHIR-12880.
issue_request: FHIR-12880 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 vocab change request to rename the CodeSystem search parameter from content to content-mode and correct the CodeSystemContentMode code/value set spelling from examplar to example.
initial_application: The request was historically pre-applied in SVN-imported commit 8af489d8ea45084a8691733cdcef333bc563ea1f, which changed the CodeSystem spreadsheet search parameter name and spelling. Current source is refactored from that spreadsheet form into XML resources, but the semantic changes remain.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/codesystem artifacts are current build inputs. Later final issues FHIR-39163 and FHIR-51110 refined the example definition without reversing the spelling correction or search-parameter rename; FHIR-53375 is an unresolved later proposal.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current SearchParameter is CodeSystem-content-mode with code content-mode and expression CodeSystem.content, and the content-mode CodeSystem contains code example while the ValueSet composes from that CodeSystem.

related_jiras.note: Revised the example content-mode definition while preserving the code introduced by FHIR-12880.
